mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates the Federal Reserve is shifting to an easing stance, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuation multiples, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5.25% triggers a risk-off reaction, compressing discount rates and reducing equity valuation multiples, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) exceeding 10,000 over 3 months signals weak labor demand, which reduces consumer spending and compresses corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in rising-claims periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) below 8,000 for 3 consecutive months indicates strengthening labor market conditions, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in falling-claims periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) exceeding 105 for 3 consecutive months signals robust manufacturing activity, which increases aggregate demand and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in high-INDPRO periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) falling below 100 for 3 consecutive months indicates contracting manufacturing activity, which compresses aggregate demand and corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in low-INDPRO periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts index (HOUST) exceeding 12,000 for 3 consecutive months signals a rebound in residential construction, which boosts consumer wealth and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in high-HOUST periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts index (HOUST) falling below 10,000 for 3 consecutive months indicates a sustained downturn in residential construction, which compresses consumer wealth and corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in low-HOUST periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
